## Houston 1.0.11

### What's new

- **New team pricing.** Each person in a paid organization costs $20 a month, or $15 a month billed yearly ($180 a year, save 25%). You choose monthly or yearly when you upgrade. Every account still has one organization on the free tier.
- **Billing in every organization.** Each organization has its own Billing tab. Owners upgrade from there. Members who need more see who to ask.
- **Confirm or change your free-tier pick.** After the switch, owners can check which organization stayed on the free tier and which one their subscription pays for, and change it for 30 days.
- **Clear status for organizations that need a plan.** An organization that isn't on the free tier and has no plan keeps working for 30 days, with a note that says when it locks. After that, you can still open it, read every conversation and move your AI Employees to another organization. New conversations wait until someone upgrades, and the owner can unlock it in one click.
- **Back to Houston after paying.** When you finish paying in the browser, Houston opens on your organization's Billing by itself.
- **A heads-up for promotional prices.** If your organization pays a promotional $15 a month, Houston tells you when it changes to $20 and lets you keep $15 a month by switching to yearly.
- **See which routines stop before removing someone.** Removing a member from a team now lists the routines that would stop running.

### Fixes and polish

- Claude no longer shows "Anthropic is having a problem" on very long conversations.
- The org chart places each AI Employee under the person who created it.
- When an app has several connected accounts without names, Houston asks which one to use.
- Clearer Spanish and Portuguese wording in billing.
- Security updates and more reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
